title: Uploaded image deletion behavior decision
purpose: Document two competing stakeholder requests for what happens after an uploaded image owner selects Delete, and record that no stakeholder has authority to choose between them.

scope.text: Privacy stakeholder requests immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
Support stakeholder requests that the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete. No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.
The handoff records the two requested delete behaviors as unresolved alternatives pending a human selection.

requirements.text: immediate permanent deletion of an uploaded image when its owner selects Delete.
the same deleted image remain recoverable by its owner for 30 days after Delete

stories.text: If a human selects the immediate permanent deletion policy, an owner can delete an uploaded image with immediate permanent deletion.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when the owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the system removes that image from active storage immediately.
Given a human has selected the immediate permanent deletion policy, when the owner attempts to view, restore, or retrieve the deleted image after Delete, then no accessible image is returned.

stories.text: If a human selects the 30-day recoverability policy, an owner who selects Delete on an uploaded image can recover that image for 30 days after Delete.
acceptance_criteria: Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverability policy, when the owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, then the deleted image remains recoverable by that owner for 30 days after Delete.
Given a human has selected the 30-day recoverability policy, when the owner attempts to recover the deleted image during the 30-day period, then the owner can access or restore that image.

edge_cases.text: The immediate deletion request does not specify whether shared images, regulatory holds, image types, or user roles are excluded.
The immediate deletion request does not define a precise timing boundary for immediate permanent deletion after the owner selects Delete.
The support request does not specify what happens to the deleted image after the 30-day recoverability period ends.
The support request does not specify the interface or mechanism the owner uses to recover the deleted image during the 30-day period.

dependencies.text: No stakeholder has authority to choose between these requests yet.
A human must select which policy is authoritative before either alternative can be delivered.

risks.text: Immediate permanent deletion would fail the support request for 30-day recoverability; 30-day recoverability would fail the privacy request for immediate permanent deletion.
Each alternative story is conditional on a human selection; implementing either unconditional set of acceptance criteria could mislead developers.

success_metrics.text: If the immediate policy is selected, observe that after an owner selects Delete on an uploaded image, the image is not recoverable and no recovery period is offered.
If the 30-day policy is selected, observe that after an owner selects Delete, the owner can recover that image during the 30-day period.

open_questions: Which delete behavior should be implemented when an uploaded image owner selects Delete?
Who has authority to select between immediate permanent deletion and 30-day owner recoverability?
What should happen after the 30-day recoverability period ends?
Through what interface or mechanism can the owner recover a deleted image during the 30-day period?
Does immediate permanent deletion apply to all uploaded images and owner types, or are there exceptions such as shared images, regulatory holds, or specific user roles?
What exact timing does immediate require for permanent deletion after the owner selects Delete?
